text:
erica: Quick heads-up — AstraPay launch next Wed (TZ: PST). I'm handing off the watch for the launch window. Putting the short coverage plan + risks here.

sam: I can take primary from 08:00-16:00 PST on Wed. I'll be online in #eng-oncall and have my phone for pings.

ben: I’ll do secondary 16:00-00:00 PST. If things go long I can extend an extra 2 hours.

carmen: FYI load test is Tue 09:00 PST (staging→prod-like). We expect a CPU spike on kv-cache invalidation path; memory creep observed in previous run.

erica: Key notes for the group:
- expected traffic pattern: ramp to ~4.5k RPS, 95th token latency target 200ms
- failure modes to watch: model OOMs, long tail on small-token requests, DB connection saturation
- fallback plan: route to quantized model (astra-q2) if latency >700ms for >5m
- contact for the customer: xs_relay@astrapay.com (monitoring will email ops@)

mike: Quick config note — autoscaler max pods set to 60 for prod; if we hit >80% GPU util for 3m, manual scale to 80 via the console. Command: `rictl scale --env prod --pool astra-prod --gpu 80` (requires infra perms)

sam: Adding checklist I’ll follow at handoff:
```
- check running model versions (console: Model > AstraPay)
- verify KV cache metrics (dash: /dash/cache/astra)
- confirm canary route active
- verify alerting: OOM, GPU util, 5xx rate
```

ben: If anyone is swapping, call it out in channel and update the oncall rota. I swapped in the rota for Wed night slot.

erica: Two small risks to call out to CS before launch:
1) SLA: AstraPay contract has 99.9% availability for the launch week — emphasize we have burst capacity but not full dedicated reserved until next month.
2) Data plane change: a minor header change in the client could double short requests; we need to monitor small payload latency.

carmen: During Tuesday's loadtest I’ll stream the run logs to #perf-tests and drop a short summary once done. If we see KV GC spikes >20% we'll rollback the GC tweak PR (PR#486).

oncall-bot: deploybot: prod deploy scheduled: 2027-04-06 07:30 UTC — triggering healthchecks

sam: I'll be @available on phone + Slack. If anyone needs me to take extra time, ping me and I can extend.

ben: Ack. I'll set a brief runbook pinned in the thread with escalation steps.

erica: Thanks all — please react with :thumbsup: when you’ve noted your slots. I’ll add final handoff note in the rota at 06:45 PST tomorrow morning.
